documents.title: Foreign Trade Policy 2023 - Chapter 4: Duty Exemption & Remission Schemes
documents.summary: Governs duty-free import of inputs physically incorporated in export products under Advance Authorisation and remission of embedded duties under RoDTEP.

documents.title: Extension and Revision of RoDTEP Rates under Appendix 4R
documents.summary: Revises RoDTEP rates and per-unit value caps for tariff items under ITC(HS) Chapter 61, including cotton knitted T-shirts (HS 6109).

rodtep_rates.description: T-shirts, singlets and other vests, knitted or crocheted, of cotton

recent_amendments.summary: Updated Appendix 4R RoDTEP schedule rate and per-piece cap for cotton knitted T-shirts.

rodtep_rates.description: Jerseys, pullovers, cardigans, waistcoats and similar articles, knitted or crocheted, of cotton

recent_amendments.summary: Revised Appendix 4R RoDTEP rate and value cap for cotton knitted pullovers/hoodies.
